form:FormGroup.label: Permission Visibility
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Filters the users and groups list: explicit, effective or all.

form:HelpHTML.p: This dropdown controls which users/groups are shown in the Users and Groups pane below.

ul.li: Show Explicit - Show only those users/groups that have an explicit application permission, i.e. one that has been directly assigned to them.

Show Effective - Show only those users/groups that have an explicit or inherited application permission. The permission may be inherited from a group they are a member of or from an ancestor of a group they are a member of.
Show All - Shows all users/groups regardless of permissions held. Select this to grant new permissions to users/groups.

form:FormGroup.label: Users and Groups
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Filtered by Permission Visibility. Select one to edit its permissions.

form:HelpHTML.p: Shows users/groups, optionally filtered based on the value of the Permission Visibility dropdown.
